description: Count the working days (Monday to Friday) between two dates, inclusive of both ends, optionally excluding England and Wales bank holidays. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Bank holiday data covers 2026 and 2027 only, so outside those years just weekends are excluded. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/working-days-calculator/

bankHolidays.description: Exclude England and Wales bank holidays as well as weekends (default true)
